long_description:
BrownTown isn’t just a comedy show – it’s a fan-favorite celebration of top South Asian and Middle Eastern comedians from across the nation. Additionally, the show includes a wildly popular Q&A where Badar, also a civil rights lawyer, poses outrageous, unrehearsed questions about race to a white comedian. Every BrownTown performance has sold out! This is a special BrownTown show presented in collaboration with The Muslim House®, which is produced by the Muslim Public Affairs Council (MPAC)® Hollywood Bureau. The show features some of the best and brownest Muslim comedians around.

Featuring: Badar Tareen, Nina Kharoufeh (headliner), Mahmoud Jaber, Yasmin Elhady, Mike Kurtz
